name: T-495 (new try)

name: S-162 (suggestion)
text: A. Prepare yourself to tend to them (get yourself into a place where you can spend time with them, have privacy, feel you can access support if you need it, and be as adult as you can be). How much of the grown-up you is actually here right now? To find out, try looking around the room, pausing before you act, making a choice and following through on it, since those are all things your adult self can do. If you can’t do that because you’re basically the frightened kid, leave the deeper conversation until later.
